shellCommands.command: git status --short; git branch -a; cat package.json; ls; find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -path ./.next -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -100
git diff; for f in next.config.ts app/*.tsx app/*/page.tsx tsconfig.json; do echo "=== $f"; cat $f; done; cat node_modules/next/package.json | grep '"version"'; git log --oneline | head

git switch -c cache-components-migration; ls node_modules/next/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rl "cacheComponents" node_modules/next/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rn "hours:" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.js | head; grep -n -A5 "hours:" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.js | head -20

cd node_modules/next/dist/docs; grep -rln "force-dynamic" . | head; f=$(grep -rl "Route segment config" 01-app | grep -i cache | head -3); echo $f; grep -rn -B2 -A12 "force-dynamic" 01-app/01-getting-started/*cache* 2>/dev/null | head -60

cd node_modules/next/dist/docs; grep -rln "cacheComponents" . | xargs grep -ln "export const revalidate" | head; grep -rn -A25 "### .*revalidate" 01-app/02-guides/migrating-to-cache-components.md 2>/dev/null | head -80; ls 01-app/02-guides | grep -i -E "cache|migrat"
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -40; echo EXIT=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
grep -rnE "instant|export const (dynamic|revalidate|fetchCache)|dynamicIO" app next.config.ts; git status --short
